pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: soc/intel/broadwell: Rework IGD's CDClk selection CDClk selection was wrong in some corner cases (e.g. ULX SKUs) and, for Broadwell, never took the devicetree config into account. Rewrite the selection with the following in mind: o cpu_is_ult() might return `true` for ULX SKUs, too, o ULX and Broadwell-ULT SKUs can be `overclocked` with additional cooling, so leave that as devicetree option. For Haswell, the following frequency selections are valid: o ULX: 337.5MHz by default, 450MHz optional o ULT: 450MHz only (maybe 337.5MHz too, documentation varies, it wasn't selectable before either) o others: 540MHz by default, 450MHz optional For Broadwell: o ULX: 450MHz by default, 337.5MHz / 540MHz optional o ULT: 540MHz by default, 337.5MHz / 450MHz / 675MHz optional o others: 667MHz by default, 337.5MHz / 450MHz / 540MHz optional Side effects: A too high setting in the devicetree results in the highest possible frequency now, Haswell non-ULT/ULX defaults to 540MHz instead of 450MHz. BUG=none BRANCH=none TEST=none Change-Id: I2539a6b66b677217a2c5e44c4fe2fc7b8b5624bc Signed-off-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org> Original-Commit-Id: e392f414cd27edba78f02a5e9274126aa0a80f89 Original-Change-Id: Iec12752f2a47bf4a5ae6077c75790eae9378c1b2 Original-Signed-off-by: Nico Huber <nico.h@gmx.de> Original-Reviewed-on: https://review.coreboot.org/17768 Original-Tested-by: build bot (Jenkins) Original-Reviewed-by: Matt DeVillier <matt.devillier@gmail.com> Original-Reviewed-by: Duncan Laurie <dlaurie@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/453358

cr50: release rw 0.0.17 This update adds the following features/fixes: - fixes SPS mode flow control to generate a single pulse per transaction - provides rollback fields' information in the sysinfo command output - marks rollback info1 space to match RW_A and RW_B headers toghether - drive CCD_MODE_L only when in CCD mode, otherwise juts watch it and react - enable wakeups from USB traffic - make sys_rsg_l a wake source on ARM platforms - add deep sleep counter (can be seen by running 'idle' command) - preserve console lock state over resets and powerdowns The new version string is as follows: cr50_v1.1.6105-4e223bc tpm2:v0.0.287-1a68fe6 cryptoc:v0.0.8-6283eee BRANCH=M-57 BUG=chrome-os-partner:63066 TEST=manual Change-Id: Ib82b46f99b45dad4d7bff50bdf0a2487cc4fe7d2 Signed-off-by: Vadim Bendebury <vbendeb@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/452751 Commit-Ready: Benson Leung <bleung@google.com> Reviewed-by: Benson Leung <bleung@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mary Ruthven <mruthven@chromium.org>
